Janice Julie NEWS FROM THE BOARDNEWS FROM THE BOARD A monthly newsletter from the Ada County Board of Commissioners March 2022 Welcome to the monthly newsletter from the Ada County Board of Commissioners. We are happy to share with you information on significant news and events happening in Ada County. Kendra Kenyon - Commissioner Rod Beck – Board Chairman Ryan Davidson - Commissioner WOMEN’S HISTORY MONTH RED SHOE RECOGNITION EVENT – MARCH 14, 2022 In celebration of Women’s History Month, Ada County Commissioners Rod Beck, Kendra Kenyon and Ryan Davidson recognized some of the trailblazing elected officials in Ada County. Those honored at the Red Shoe Recognition event included the late Linda Lund Davis, the first woman Ada County Commissioner; Dotti Owens, the first woman Ada County Coroner; Judge Deborah Bail, the first woman District Judge in Idaho; Judge Karen Vehlow, the first woman Ada County Magistrate; and Jan Bennetts, the first woman Ada County Prosecuting Attorney. Congratulations on your achievements!

ADA COUNTY CORONER’S OFFICE GROUNDBREAKING Congratulations to the Ada County Coroner’s Office on the March 17, 2022 groundbreaking for a new state-of-the-art Coroner’s facility in Meridian. The facility will serve all of Ada County as well as dozens of other Idaho counties and will allow the Coroner’s office to better accommodate a rapidly growing population. The facility is scheduled to be complete in 2023. Officials attend the Ada County Coroner’s Office groundbreaking for a new state-of-the art facility in Meridian. Ada County Director of Operations Bruce Krisko welcomes attendees to the March 17th groundbreaking Ada County Commissioner Ryan Davidson, Ada County Commission Chairman Rod Beck, Ada County Operations Project Manager Deborah Phillips, Ada County Director of Operations Bruce Krisko Ada County Coroner Dotti Owens 4

Ada County Commission Chairman Rod Beck Ada County Commissioner Ryan Davidson Ada County Commissioner Kendra Kenyon ATTENTION SENIORS – YOU GET A TRASH BILLING PRICE BREAK Do you live in Unincorporated Ada County? Are you over 65? If so, you are eligible for a reduced trash pickup rate! Remember, you must live outside the city limits (see the map) and you’ll need to show proof of your age. Take advantage of this benefit for Ada County residents! Proof of age can be submitted by email to: acbs@adacounty.id.gov or by mail to: Ada County Trash Billing PO Box 2780 Boise, ID 83701 Please reference your six-digit trash account number or your property address to ensure proper processing of your discounted service. Note: Residents of Ada County who live outside city limits are serviced by Hardin Sanitation. 5
